problems: The blind guess (umbrella with a shaft and hooked handle) does not match the intended kite. The figure reads as a diamond kite with a tail and streamers, not an umbrella.
The kite frame is too thin to read as a silhouette. Only the left wing edge and a short spine are drawn, and the right wing is missing, so the diamond does not close.
The gold and blue lines run along the same paths, so the figure looks like a copy of the gold connector lines rather than a body outline.
Labels collide and are truncated: the crown label overlaps the left wing label, and the 'lower-left spar node' label sits on the wing edge. Labels such as 'wh', 'branc' and 'flick' are cut off.
The tail and streamers are hard to read as cloth. The name-strip (93506) and the ribbon flutter (92041) are single thin strokes with no width, so they do not look like cloth.

The figure is upright (crown at top, tail hanging down), and the stars are roughly on their named parts: crown 93057 near (248,247), left wing tip 94141 near (177,246), lower corner near (268,290), name-knot 92855 near (262,380), strip end 93506 near (221,471).
